name: O Porriño to Redondela
notes: from is O Porriño (end of stage 6). Xunta de Galicia stage O Porriño to Redondela, with Mos and O Souto on the way. Mos: the civil parish relation (relation/12684582), 0.83 km from the OSM route; the municipality relation is 0.77 km away and was not used. O Souto: hamlet node in Redondela (Nominatim also finds places called O Souto in Mos and in Vigo, 2.4 and 3.1 km from the route; not used). Redondela: place=town node from Photon, 0.06 km from the route. coastal is true: Redondela lies at the head of the Ría de Vigo, and an OSM API map call around the town finds natural=coastline ways (the nearest node is 0.08 km from a point 0.4 km west of the town point). The relation 12786089 (also named Caminho Português de Santiago, but ref CPC, A Guarda to Redondela, the Costa route) ends here too and is excluded by route_exclude_regex. Checked against OSM relation 12786090 (Caminho Português de Santiago, ref CP), read through the OSM API on 2026-11-07: the 15.9 km between the two ends stay within 0.89 km of the straight lines through these points. Published figures seen, not copied into distance_km: Rother 16.7 km, Vagamundos 16 km.
